# Billing
> capability: billing | key: BIL | updated: 2026-10-01

## Purpose
How a charge is settled.

## Requirements

### Requirement: BIL-R1 Settle a charge
When a charge is settled, the system SHALL keep the amount.

#### Scenario: BIL-R1.S1 Amount kept
- GIVEN an amount of 10
- WHEN it is settled
- THEN the result is 10
